newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Akademiska Hus CP A1 plus short term.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Akademiska Hus CP A1 plus short term.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it assigned its A1 plus short-term rating to the three billion crown Swedish commerical paper programme of Statliga Akademiska AB (Akademiska Hus).
Akademiska Hus's AA long-term and A1 plus short-term issuer credit ratings, as well as the AA rating assigned to the five billion crown medium-term note programme, are affirmed, S&P said.
The outlook on the ratings are stable, S&P said.

"The ratings reflect the government ownership, the Swedish state's strong involvement in the higher education sector, Akademiska Hus' domination on the university premises market in Sweden, and the stable customer base," S&P said in a statement.
The company was formed in October 1993 and manages 2.3 billion square meters of university premises to a total book value of around 15 billion crowns, S&P said.
